metadata.description: Registry of Hydra's built-in type classes.

literal.string: Check whether a type is an instance of a constraint class, by the class's short name, resolving nominal types through the given schema.
The equality type class: instances support structural equality.
Fractional: instances support total floating-point division.
The fractional type class: instances support total floating-point division.
Integral: instances support integer division, modulus, remainder, and parity.
The integral type class: instances support integer division, modulus, remainder, and parity.
Check whether a type is comparable (an instance of equality and ordering), resolving nominal types through the given schema.
Numeric: instances support arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, negation).
The numeric type class: instances support arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, negation).
Ordering: instances support total ordering (and equality).
The ordering type class: instances support total ordering (and equality).
